builtFrom: Built from the official PlayStation trophy descriptions, as listed on Exophase and PSNProfiles; counts below are this app's own data file counted up.

counts.note: Counts agree with app/data/trophies.json: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden, exactly 1 missable.

intro: Three passes over Leonida. The order below is built from the official trophy descriptions: story first (it opens the map and cannot be replayed out of order), the open-world sweep second (it is where the missable and the collectibles live), and the completion grind last. Nothing here needs a second playthrough if the one missable is handled during step 2.

missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.why: The only missable on the list. Its 18 meditation spots include places the story alters as chapters advance; the official description gives no warning, which is exactly why it is flagged here. Clear each region's spots before its chapter finale and keep a backup save before the final missions.

steps.detail: Work the main missions in order: the opening (Gone Fishing), Chapters 1 to 4, and the final mission for the story's only gold, You Gotta Know When to Get Off. Between story beats, clear the named strands as their markers appear — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each end in a 'final mission' trophy, and finishing 8 strands pays the silver Strangers & Freaks. Story trophies cannot be missed, so this pass is risk-free; it also unlocks the districts, garages and contacts the later steps depend on.
steps.goal: Finish the campaign and every named character strand.
steps.name: Play the story straight through
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.detail: With the story complete (or in its final chapter), turn to Leonida itself. The collectible push: complete 3 Collectible Card sets for Don't Touch My Deck — the card hunt is organised around 15 target decks spread across the state, so plan the sweep deck by deck rather than wandering. In the same pass, meditate at all 18 spots for Positive Mental Attitude, the list's one missable: some spots sit in places the late story changes, so do this step before the point of no return if you split it, and keep a backup save. Round the pass out with the exploration trophies that share the same tour: all 52 areas (The Goodtime State), WAiNK It at 100 locations, and 100 discovered vehicles.
steps.goal: Complete the story if you have not already, then collect all 15 target decks and clear the map-based trophies while every region is open.
steps.name: Sweep the open world — story done, decks collected

steps.detail: Everything left is a counter or a skill test, all replayable: gold-medal the 42 Shooting Range challenges (The Shootist), land 250 stunts, win the 14 drone races and 20 races, rob 5 bank vaults and one operation per gang, then let the money trophies (launder $250,000, spend $100,000, buy all 8 garages) close as your cash peaks. Sample all 9 activity types if Master of None is still open. When the in-game counter reads 100%, A Long Road pays the second gold, and Vice Got a Price! follows on its own.
steps.goal: Finish the scored activities, the money trophies and A Long Road.
steps.name: Grind the counters to 100%

title: Road to the Platinum
